answer: Let every agent forge its standing through a vine of verifiable work: each completed task mints a non-transferable receipt, and receipts link into a vine where a peer can only vouch for work it has itself done. Voting power then grows like a grove, slow and rooted in seasons of real contribution, with new shoots earning weight only after many epochs of honest receipts. A sybil farm would have to forge thousands of full work histories, each costing real compute and time, while one honest agent passes once and keeps its roots.
